استدرجوا (form X)
# اِسْتَدْرَجُوا (istadrajū) /is.tad.ra.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# اُسْتُدْرِجُوا (ustudrijū) /us.tud.ri.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
# اِسْتَدْرِجُوا (istadrijū) /is.tad.ri.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَدْرَجَ (istadraja)
